properties.description: Record how a human resolved a merge conflict — content-keyed (property + base/ours/theirs values, node-independent) — and offer it back when the same conflict recurs. Stored in the graph as an answered Question whose id IS the content key (rr: prefix; the Question schema has no source field, so the prefix distinguishes it and it stays invisible to open_questions). Advisory: recall_resolutions surfaces the recorded choice; the human confirms, or bulk-accepts via apply_merge use_recorded. BUILT + VERIFIED (art:merge, ver:merge): resolution_key on each property/edge-property conflict, record on apply, recall_resolutions tool. Extends cap:merge-designs; BL-80 #5. v1 covers property + edge-property conflicts (node-type/delete-modify keys deferred).
properties.name: Reuse a recorded conflict resolution (rerere)
